title: Mount
subject: gated-scoped-ac

claims.text: The engine is constructed once at app boot. Reconstructing per request is a misuse.
The engine receives the Drizzle schema and `sql` helpers directly. No intermediate normalization is the consumer's responsibility.
The Hono middleware receives the engine and the bag-builder. It does no auth itself.
Boot is the only place misconfiguration can be detected. The engine throws if rules, schema, or hierarchy are inconsistent.

**Why.** Authorization needs identical inputs across the app. Constructing the engine once at boot and binding it to a middleware once gives every route the same engine, the same compile, and the same trust boundary.

**How.** `createScopedAc(...)` runs validation, builds the internal Drizzle filter builder, and returns a `ScopedAc`. `createScopeMiddleware({ engine, buildContext })` wraps it for Hono. The middleware calls `buildContext(c)` per request, expands roles via the engine, and stashes a pre-bound `ScopedAcRequestContext` on the Hono context.

**Why this way.** The engine is a configured object, not a class hierarchy. The bag-builder is the trust boundary — keeping it as a function the consumer supplies makes it the explicit place where session/auth verification ends and authorization begins.

reference.statement: **What.** The single mount point that turns a configured engine + a request bag-builder into a Hono middleware. After mount, every route handler has `c.get("scopedAc")` populated with effective roles and bound CRUD methods.

reference.statement: `buildContext` is called per request after auth has verified the session. Return `null` to short-circuit with 401 (or 403 if `unauthenticatedStatus: 403` is configured). **Never put unverified request body or unsigned cookie data into the bag** — see `SECURITY.md`.

claims.text: In route handlers, use `getScopedAcContext(c)` instead of raw `c.get(...)` for type narrowing.

snippets.caption: ts

claims.text: entity referenced in a rule but missing from `schema`
field referenced on an entity but missing from that entity's `columns`
subject referenced as `$session.x` but not in `subjects`
multi-segment field path that isn't the entity's declared metadata column
metadata column declared but not present in `columns`
hierarchy edge to an undeclared role
(strict mode) rule with empty context AND empty target ("god mode")
(warning) rule with traversal target on a role that includes `create` or `delete` actions — that combination is inert
These all surface at boot, not at first request.

imagesAndDiagrams.value:
| Field | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `strictGodMode` | `false` | When true, empty-context-AND-empty-target rules fail boot |
| `contextKey` (middleware) | `"scopedAc"` | Hono context variable name |
| `unauthenticatedStatus` | `401` | Status when `buildContext` returns `null` |

reference.topic: Reference › Where this engine and the middleware should not be reconstructed

claims.text: Per request — the engine is stateless after boot; rebuilding is wasted work and bypasses validation
Inside a route handler — handlers consume `c.get("scopedAc")`, not a fresh engine
Inside a repository — repos receive the engine via DI from the module mount
The only place that constructs the engine is the file you put your `createScopedAc(...)` call in.
